content_binding: Each candidate input index binds candidate ID and coordinate map.
Every candidate input record binds exact system source SHA-256 and the complete factor-base family manifest SHA-256.
Every factor-base manifest shard joins to the S3 file index by path, compressed bytes and SHA-256.
Every certificate is replayed in a fresh process and binds the unchanged system source SHA-256.

directory_tree.S3_PERSISTENCE_INDEX.json: Manifest of every source, input, equation, certificate, replay, summary and structural index object with S3 URI, byte count and SHA-256.
directory_tree.candidate-base-top-panel.json: Aggregate 624-row table with candidate bit, family, m, target kind, source hash, base-manifest hash and exact/censored result.
directory_tree.candidate-inputs/spikeN/CASE_ID/input.js: One source-bound input record for one family/m/target case.
directory_tree.candidate-inputs/spikeN/CASE_ID/system.s: Original unmodified Singular presentation generated from candidate-bound points and target; exact byte SHA-256 in input.json.
directory_tree.candidate-inputs/spikeN/inputs.json: Array of 48 typed input records, ordered by family, m and target kind.
directory_tree.top-certificates/spikeN/CASE_ID.json: Native certificate for the quotient by the original highest homogeneous component of every original equation.
directory_tree.top-certificates/spikeN/summary.json: Per-candidate top certificate statuses and intervals.
directory_tree.top-replays/spikeN/replay-summary.json: Fresh-process replay of every available certificate.

panel.base_reuse: The exact complete family/r factor-base manifest is reused for m=2..9.

purpose: Structural contract for candidate PDP input systems, top-form degree-of-regularity certificates, replay records, and S3 custody.
retention: Append-only. Failed jobs, partial source files, failed projections, censored outcomes, invalid predictions and prior model versions are retained.
status: format_contract_only; generated candidate input and certificate files are not present yet

value_semantics.dreg_exact: First degree d for which the graded quotient by the original highest homogeneous forms vanishes, only when the source-bound certificate proves equality.
value_semantics.finite_interval: Certified lower and upper bounds; preserve both endpoints and the certificates.
value_semantics.positive_dimensional_top_ideal: No finite vanishing degree for this quotient presentation; this is not infinite Castelnuovo-Mumford regularity.
value_semantics.unresolved: No exact or finite interval certificate; timeout, missing proof or failed check stays explicit and is never converted into a label.
